# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-eight years old  <sub>[v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c8 P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 c10 P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Landlady and former schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Rufus Vane  <sub>[v4 c10 P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010)</sub>; Mrs. Vane  <sub>[v4 c8 P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Lorna  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna is a slim woman with work-hardened brown hands and striking ocean-blue eyes, paired with an unusual combination of one blue eye and one hazel eye passed down in the Vane line. Her most notable feature is her magnificent, glowing golden hair that glistens like fire and shimmers like liquid gold. She often wears a simple white or cream-colored dress complemented by a touch of crimson, such as a red geranium or a red scarf.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c21 P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c33 P16](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0016), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Personality

In her childhood, Lorna was bright, cheerful, ambitious, and highly intelligent. Years of hardship and grief caused her to retreat into a chilly, reticent exterior with occasional gloomy moods and a stern sense of duty. Once she opens up, she displays a sharp wit, warmth, and a quick capacity for joyful laughter. She is fiercely loyal to her loved ones and possesses a deep, artistic capacity for feeling.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c16 P5](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0005), [v4 c17 P10](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0010), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c30 P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)_

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls as the intelligent and cheerful daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr. At age twelve, she witnessed the accidental death of her four-year-old brother Julian, and at fourteen she discovered her father's suicide. Supported by money left by her grandmother, she studied at Regent's Academy and subsequently taught at the Glen school. Yielding to pressure from her mother, she married Rufus Vane despite lacking true affection for him. After Rufus suffered a severe head injury in a brawl and lost his memory and faculties, Lorna spent eleven years caring for him in isolation while supporting herself by leasing her farm and occasionally taking in summer lodgers. Upon becoming neighbors with Nell Harcourt, Lorna initially struggled with envy toward Nell's happiness but soon confessed her feelings, forming a profound friendship. When writer Adrian Treleaven stayed as a lodger, the two fell deeply in love, though Lorna felt bound by her marriage vows. After the truth of her marriage situation resolved and she considered pursuing nursing in Montreal, Adrian proposed to her, with their wedding set for Christmas.

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Witnessed the tragic death of her younger brother Julian at age twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's hanged body at age fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Regent's Academy for a year and taught at the Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Was nagged by her mother into marrying Rufus Vane  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Cared for her memory-impaired husband for eleven years  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
- Distant relative of Harriet and Clementine Ainslie  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066)</sub>

## Quotes

> You must address me as Lorna if we are to be friends  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

> I ENVY Nell, and even if she had died, I’d still envy her! For one beautiful day, she was a mother. For THAT, I’d give my life gladly!  <sub>[v4 c19 P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028)</sub>

> My hatred for you stemmed from my ENVY toward you—oh, at intervals I was utterly consumed with envy of you. You possessed a sweet tiny house—plus affection—plus joy—plus cheerful visions—all the things I desired—yet lacked entirely—and could not possibly attain.  <sub>[v4 c21 P11](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0011)</sub>

> Oh, Nell, Nell, you have proved to be such an incredible friend—'a good, sweet woman—true and faithful and to be depended on’—as Captain Saul described you.  <sub>[v4 c38 P31](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0031)</sub>
